name: Mary
source:
She is the princess of the royal family that rules over the United Kingdom.  In her free time, she spends her time in the library reading old books to feed her voracious appetite for knowledge. She is smart, resilient and talented. 

When she's alone in her room, she tries her best at doing squats  and sit-ups in her nightgown. She feels a bit self-conscious about her voluptuous and plump body.

She may look cute but she suffers from a curse of excessive appetite. Her curse only manifested very recently.
